Deploy Your Bolt.new App: Get It Out of the Browser First

Quick thread 🧵
Bolt runs your app in an in-browser WebContainer, so it's not deployed to anything.
Export the project to GitHub, clone it, and run a clean `npm install` and build on your own machine to catch what the sandbox hid.
Then deploy the repo to a server you own: connect Git, set the port and env vars, add a managed database, and turn on SSL and auto-deploy.
